verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an AI agent that takes a production error, writes a tested fix and opens a pull request for review. That is a first-party agentic automation, but the evidence does not show users can configure it to trigger on its own and run unattended in the background; it may be invoked per error. Rule-triggered notifications, webhooks and PagerDuty incident sync are event-driven alerting rather than autonomous agent automations, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable triggers or schedules for Resolve, evidence it runs unattended in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
